posts.title: Heat Pump Mid-Season Performance Review
posts.description: Last year we replaced our (methane) gas boiler with an air-source heat pump. We’re a few months into the heating season, so time for an update on how it’s going.

posts.title: Clearing the Air
posts.description: I’ve just finished reading the “sequel” to Not the End of the World by Hannah Ritchie, Clearing the Air (A Hopeful Guide to Solving Climate Change - in 50 Questions and Answers), which I got for Christmas.

posts.title: Greener Nights History
posts.description: I recently made some small changes to my simple mobile-friendly web app to display the daily “Greener Nights” forecast from the Octopus Energy GB API.
